source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, adhyaya 1
structure: Every episode: RECAP (≈3 s, not in episode 1; KIT.series.recapStrip) → HOOK (one question; the episode title follows it: KIT.series.episodeTitle) → STORY → NEXT (a cliffhanger line, then the teaser card: KIT.series.nextTeaser).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice, used by the timeline), say (what is spoken, if not `text`): '…' and '—' pause, ',' and '.' pause a little, [p:400] pauses 400 ms, {s:0.8} speaks what follows at 0.8× until the next {s:…} ({s} resets).

lines.text: Where did the greatest story ever told begin?
lines.note: HOOK. beats = 'greatest' (an empty throne flares in gold), 'told' (the dice tumble)

lines.text: Not on a battlefield… but in a quiet forest.
lines.note: beats = 'battlefield' (crossed arrows flare and burn away), 'quiet' (the last ember rises); the episode title shows in the post (KIT.series.episodeTitle)

lines.text: In the Naimisha forest, sages kept a sacred fire burning… for twelve years.
lines.note: the clearing; beats = 'Naimisha' (the place name in gold), 'twelve' (the days and nights race)
the forest at dawn: a lone walker with a staff, heading for the smoke of the ashram

lines.text: His name was Ugrashravas — called Sauti.
lines.note: beats[0] = the name: gold lettering lands on it; the epithet carries 'called Sauti' (the name the series uses)

lines.text: The sages asked him for the story he heard at King Janamejaya's great sacrifice…
lines.note: beats[0] = 'King': the court vision forms in the smoke

lines.text: …the story composed by Vyasa. The Mahabharatam.
lines.note: beats[0] = the title word: it blooms in gold

lines.text: And Sauti began — with a field of blood.
lines.say: And Sauti began — {s:0.9}with a field of blood.
lines.note: NEXT (cliffhanger). beats = 'began' (he raises his hand to the fire), 'blood' (the fire and smoke turn red)

lines.text: Next: The Field of Five Lakes.
lines.say: Next: [p:200] The Field of Five Lakes.
lines.note: the teaser card (KIT.series.nextTeaser) shows strings.nextLabel / nextEpisodeLabel / nextTitle and a glimpse of episode 2's red lakes
